gen-amatic-sc-gf-golos-text: Thin, wiry strokes that wander like squeezed toothpaste lead the way. Golos Text follows in a plain sans, its tall lowercase filling the line so the quirky heading has something sturdy to lean on.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-graduate: Amatic SC draws its letters with a casual, pen-on-paper looseness, with terminals that stop well short of the stem. Graduate, a serif, stays bookish and generously spaced beneath it; the heading earns its place big and brief.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-hanuman: Wire-cut lettering meets old-school polish. Amatic SC has straight-edged, constant strokes that feel rustic and a bit quirky, while Hanuman, a classic serif, answers with a high-waisted lowercase and refined, wide-set terminals on its s.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Amatic SC looks drawn with a round-tipped pen, all rustic quirk and casual wobble, with terminals that stop far from the stem. It brings the personality, and Hedvig Letters Sans, a sans-serif, brings the clarity.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-heebo: Straight-edged, constant strokes make Amatic SC look cut from wire, rustic and a touch quirky. Heebo, a plain sans with a tall central band, would swallow it if the heading were made small, so let the heading stay big.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-hind-guntur: Hind Guntur reads modern and sturdy, like stamped metal type with open curves. Amatic SC's squeezed-toothpaste handwriting sits above it, loosening the page with a rustic, pen-and-paper wobble that the sans keeps in check.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-hind-madurai: Amatic SC has terminals that stop far from the stem, drawn in a rustic, quirky line of toothpaste. Hind Madurai, a plain sans, simply fills the line with wide-open s curves and approachable text.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-hind-mysuru: Rustic handwriting, then crisp text. Amatic SC sets the quirky tone, while Hind Mysuru, a sans, presses its lowercase close to ascender height; give that body font a little extra size for comfort.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-hind-siliguri: Quirky and rustic, Amatic SC squeezes its strokes out like toothpaste, with terminals that stop far from the stem. Hind Siliguri, a plain sans, hums along beneath in a flat gray line.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-huninn: Amatic SC's strokes look squeezed from a tube, quirky and rustic, with terminals stopping far from the stem. Huninn, a sans-serif, keeps long text modern and tidy, its lowercase rising close to cap height with crossbars as fat as the stems.
